podcast.body: A fan club album recorded entirely by Damon Albarn on his iPad during the 2010 World Tour, released during the "Phase 4: Humans After All" era. "This era included a fan club album entitled The Fall, which was recorded entirely by Damon on his iPad during that 2010 World Tour."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album experienced a major commercial failure, directly attributable to having practically no promotional spending whatsoever, which led the band to a disastrous period. It is occasionally favored by the most demanding of the band's fans for its unique qualities. "incluso de Fod, directamente no ha tenido prácticamente ningún tipo de gasto promocional, y eso ha llevado a la banda el desastre."
